answer:
I added a "Weather in Porto now" card to the App side of your Porto weekend note. I haven't seen it show real weather yet. The check I ran only used sample data and doesn't make the live request.

I can't look up the weather myself, so the card fetches it live. It shows the current temperature, what it feels like, conditions, wind and humidity. The data comes from Open-Meteo, which is free and needs no key. The first time you open the App side, Amber Notes will ask you to approve `api.open-meteo.com`. Until you do, the card says the weather is unavailable.

I also made the checklist tick boxes a bit bigger so they're easier to tap. Your note's text is unchanged.
